pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of grid/multi-entry averaging during active drawdown windows; additions permitted only after a minimum of +$10 unrealized profit and confirmed structural breakout.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory ATR volatility filter combined with order book imbalance check; no entry allowed when 1-minute spread exceeds historical median by >150%.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop activation once profit reaches +$8.00 to lock in a minimum +$4.00 baseline.
